ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) field interspersed with high-intensity (white) punctate spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Numerous discrete circular white blobs are distributed non-uniformly across the dark ventral plane, with higher density on the outer halves of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and a depth-to-width ratio indicating significant penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes are visible across the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broadly convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, textured white circular pixel clusters are localized on the outer margins of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Numerous isolated circular white spots are scattered across the medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the left lobe, extending from the central region toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the left lobe and significant barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'starfield' distribution of fine white pigmentation spots across the dark surface of the ventral fluke.
